pages.text: Fertilizers are used to add nutrients to $(l:agriculture/growing_crops)crops$(). $(item)$(k:key.use)$() with a fertilizer in your hand on some $(thing)Farmland$(), $(l:agriculture/greenhouse#planters)Planter$() or a $(thing)Crop$() to add the nutrients. Particles should appear, indicating the fertilizer was added.$(br)You can find nutrient information in a fertilizers tooltip. The next few pages list some early game fertilizers.
pages.title: Fertilization

pages.text: Compost is the product of the $(l:agriculture/composter)Composter$(). $(br)$(li)$(b)Nitrogen: 40$()$(li)$(6)Phosphorous: 20$()$(li)$(d)Potassium: 40$()
Bonemeal is made of crushed bones. $(br)$(li)$(6)Phosphorous: 10$()
Saltpeter is made from its ore. $(br)$(li)$(b)Nitrogen: 10$()$(li)$(d)Potassium: 40$()
Guano is found deep underground and on gravelly shores. $(br)$(li)$(b)Nitrogen: 80$()$(li)$(6)Phosphorous: 50$()$(li)$(d)Potassium: 10$()
Wood ash is produced by breaking firepits. Throwing a torch item into water also has a chance to produce ash. $(br)$(li)$(6)Phosphorous: 10$()$(li)$(d)Potassium: 30$()
Sylvite is made from its ore. $(br)$(li)$(d)Potassium: 50$()
